critical_code_review_comments: new.tsx line 113 useMemo `totals` is now declared BEFORE the useEffect at line 129 that reads totals.total — the temporal dead zone crash is resolved. Hook order remains stable across renders.

Auto-fill effect only writes paid when paymentType==='cash' — user-entered value in Credit mode is preserved.

rca_of_issue: Original crash: useEffect at (old line ~62) referenced `totals.total` in its dependency array while `totals` useMemo was declared later in the same component. JavaScript's temporal dead zone throws 'Cannot access totals before initialization' during initial render because the const binding exists but is not yet initialised when the effect body/deps are evaluated. Fix (verified): the effect that auto-fills Paid=Total in Cash mode was moved to line 129, immediately AFTER the `totals` useMemo declaration on line 113. Hook order is preserved. Verified by (a) fresh navigation, (b) hard reload, (c) full end-to-end save flow — none reproduced the error and console captured 0 errors.
